_comment: #9 QW-5 -- the Queue panel epic's closing exit-gate slice.
Seeds enough of `coord drive`'s queue to drive the whole panel in one
real `coord web --fixture` process: two repos (so the repo-scope
dropdown has more than one option to switch between), two adjacent
waiting rows in 'repo-alpha' (so a Move-up/down button has a real
neighbour to swap with), and one 'blocked' row in 'repo-beta' (so the
Unblock button is enabled rather than disabled-with-tooltip).
'repo-alpha'#9101 also has a matching `board.assignments` entry, so
clicking its Issue-cell link lands on a REAL pipeline detail page
(issue_title visible), not `Detail`'s own not-found state -- proving
the link's `repo_name`/`issue_number` round-trip through
`paths.pipelineItem` correctly, not just that some route matched.
#9102 and #9201 deliberately have no matching assignment -- the Title
cell for those rows is expected to render the empty-cell dash, which is
the documented, intentional fallback (`queueTitleCell` in
src/lib/driveQueue.ts), not a fixture omission.
In fixture mode `POST /api/drive-queue/action` is recorded, never
executed (`coord/dashboard/fixture.py`), so a Move/Unblock click's
server round trip always reports success without actually reordering
these rows server-side -- the reorder the e2e spec asserts on is the
CLIENT's own optimistic swap (`applyQueueMoveOptimistic`), exactly like
`DriveQueuePanel.test.tsx`'s unit-level equivalent.
